data.one_liner: Check for custom in-app updates and download APKs on Android.
data.what_it_does: Checks a remote JSON file for application updates, displays an update dialog, and downloads/installs the update file on Android devices.
use_when: You distribute Android apps outside the Google Play Store and need a custom in-app update mechanism.
You want to fetch update metadata from a remote JSON file.
avoid_when: You are building for iOS (iOS is not supported by this plugin).
You prefer using official platform stores (like Google Play In-App Updates).
strengths: Supports pause, resume, and cancel for ongoing downloads.
Customizable dialog texts, UI elements, and force-update support via minSupport.
weaknesses: Requires manual setup of the REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission on Android.
data.setup_notes: Add the REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission to the AndroidManifest.xml and specify the version code in pubspec.yaml.
